channel.title: Department of War News Feed
channel.description: Stories from around the Department of War.

item.title: Operation Unified Resolve Sees 70% Drop in Rio Grande Valley Crossings
item.description: Just 30 days after U.S. Northern Command and Joint Task Force Southern Border repositioned hundreds of service members to Texas' Rio Grande Valley, illegal crossings and suspicious activity in the sector have plummeted by about 70%.
item.dc:creator: Pentagon News

item.title: Army WCAP Women Wrestlers Help Team USA Capture World Title
item.description: Two women's freestyle wrestlers from the U.S. Army World Class Athlete Program helped Team USA secure its first world title since 1999 during the United World Wrestling Senior World Championships in Astana, Kazakhstan.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Warns, U.S. Army World Class Athlete Program

item.title: Army Medical Center Tests Emergency Readiness During Mass Casualty Exercise
item.description: Brooke Army Medical Center participated in an annual mass casualty exercise at Joint Base San Antonio-Fort Sam Houston, Texas, to test the hospital's emergency preparedness and response capabilities.
item.dc:creator: Rodolfo Arispe, Brooke Army Medical Center Public Affairs

item.title: USS George Washington Sailors Vote While Deployed
item.description: Sailors aboard the aircraft carrier USS George Washington, currently deployed to the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations in the Middle East, recently voted during a voting rodeo event held in the ship's library.
item.dc:creator: Pentagon News

item.title: Idaho Army National Guard Conducts Remote Rescue Mission
item.description: The Idaho Army National Guard assisted with a search and rescue mission near New Meadows, Idaho, marking the second time in as many months the team has supported local fire and emergency medical services in a remote part of the state.
item.dc:creator: Army Maj. Robert Taylor, Idaho National Guard

item.title: Coast Guard Cutter Stratton Returns Home After Lengthy Northern Patrol
item.description: The crew of the Coast Guard cutter Stratton returned to their home port after a 103-day patrol in the Arctic and Bering Sea, where they worked to reinforce maritime safety, security and national sovereignty in one of the most demanding operating areas in the world.
item.dc:creator: U.S. Coast Guard Pacific Area

item.title: Western Hemisphere Nations Meet to Advance Anti-Cartel Campaign Plan
item.description: Defense and security leaders from 19 Western Hemisphere nations worked on a campaign plan to dismantle transnational cartels and narco-terrorist networks during an Americas Counter Cartel Coalition forum in the Dominican Republic.
item.dc:creator: U.S. Southern Command Public Affairs

item.title: Assistant Secretary Says New Infrastructure Initiatives Are a 'National Calling'
item.description: The War Department embarked this year on new initiatives to strengthen the infrastructure of military installations and to build a new prototype American base, said Dale Marks, assistant secretary of war for energy, installations and environment.
item.dc:creator: Douglas E. Jessmer

item.title: Marine Corps Base Hawaii Barracks Project Crosses Halfway Mark
item.description: Construction of two new barracks at Marine Corps Base Hawaii has passed the halfway mark, with structural work complete and crews installing building systems and finishing the interior.
item.dc:creator: Theanne Tangen, Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Hawaii

item.title: Army Mountain Division Takes on Panamanian Jungle
item.description: Soldiers assigned to the 10th Mountain Division tackled Panama's challenging jungle terrain during a 12-day training course designed to strengthen unit cohesion, develop leaders and sharpen combat skills.
item.dc:creator: Army Pfc. Carolyn Dodge
